**Fixes**
- Windows 11 shows Shell's menu again after the November 2026 update (KB5132061) on 24H2, 25H2 and 26H2. The update brought in Windows' new right-click menu, which ignored the setting Shell uses to switch back to the classic menu. Shell now turns the new menu off as well, so you don't need ViVeTool or other tweaks. Register Shell again or install this version, and the menu comes back.
- Creating a new folder or file from Shell's menu on the desktop (`io.dir.create`, `io.file.create`) no longer makes Explorer restart. Thanks to TiAmo-KO for the report (#8).
- Shell loads as soon as Windows starts again, so the first right-click on the taskbar after signing in shows Shell's menu, not Windows' own. This needs the installer (all users); the portable version still loads with the first right-click on the desktop or a folder. Thanks to fengyulll for the report (#12).
